And the smoke rose so high, it turned into big dark clouds.
And then... rain! Heavy rain, right on the lava!
The lava cooled down... and stopped!
Herberg is safe! Everyone can go back to normal life.
New: a statue for our firefighter heroes.
And a weather station, to watch the volcano.
But the volcano is still alive. We still need the lava wall.
So keep sharing and keep liking! At one thousand shares, we build it.
